units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 14:2">Kel. XIV, 2</cite> <he>עשאן לנוי</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>לנוֹאי</he>) he attached them for ornamentation.

<cite ref="Yevamot 39b:17">Yeb. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>הכונס את יבמתו … לשם נ׳</he> he who married his deceased brother’s wife (v. <cite ref="J00062"><he>יְבָמָה</he></cite>) for her beauty (not with the intention of perpetuating his brother’s name).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:4:8">Y. Maasr. III, end, 51ᵃ</cite> <he>לנוֹיָיהּ של חצר</he> to embellish the court.

<cite ref="Zevachim 54b:3">Zeb. 54ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>בנוית</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 19:18">I Sam. XIX, 18</cite>) <he>עוסקין בנוֹיוֹ של וכ׳</he> engaged in the embellishment of the world (consulting about building the Temple). Koh. R. to II, 12 <he>והוא נוֹאוֹ</he> and this (the nose) is man’s beauty; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:1">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>נאה</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>בעלת נ׳</he> a handsome woman; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נוֹיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:64">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>בנוֹיוֹתָיו</he> (not <he>בנויתיו</he>), v. <cite ref="N00010"><he>נָאֶה</he></cite>.

B. Bath. 24ᵇ משום נויי העיר because of the health of the town (which suffers from trees; Rashi: because of the beauty of the town which requires an open space all around); Y. ib. II, 13ᶜ top שניאו רע; Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ bot. נִיוְיָהּ, v. נָוֶה II.
